# Sales Forecasting Dashboard

Forecast future values from historical synthetic sales data.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Date features and data validation
- [ ] Baseline forecast and model comparison
- [ ] Error metrics and forecast visualization

Use synthetic or properly licensed data. Do not commit credentials or personal data. Document setup, evaluation, limitations, and reset instructions.
